entities.name: UniProt A1VGB6
observations: Exact full-length sequence match (257 aa) to reviewed tryptophan synthase alpha chain from Nitratidesulfovibrio vulgaris strain DP4.
Catalyzes indoleglycerol-phosphate cleavage to indole and glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate; annotated EC 4.2.1.20.
Part of L-tryptophan biosynthesis; reference annotation places enzyme in cytosol and describes an alpha2beta2 tetramer.

entities.name: Tryptophan synthesis step
observations: Reference reaction: indoleglycerol phosphate + L-serine → glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate + L-tryptophan + H2O (Rhea RHEA:10532).

entities.name: L-tryptophan biosynthesis
observations: Reference annotation assigns this alpha subunit to the final step of L-tryptophan biosynthesis from chorismate.
